parameters.name: width
parameters.tooltip: Width of the chair seat in meters. The installed generator samples 0.4–0.5 meters.

parameters.name: size
parameters.tooltip: Front-to-back size of the seat in meters.

parameters.name: leg_height
parameters.tooltip: Length of the chair legs below the seat, in meters.

parameters.name: back_height
parameters.tooltip: Height of the backrest above the seat, in meters.

parameters.name: back_type
parameters.tooltip: Choose a solid, partial, or bar backrest. Studio calls post_init to rebuild the derived profile.
